#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iterator>

using namespace std;

int positive(int x) {
    return x > 0 ? x : 0;
}

int main() {
    vector<int> nums;
    int x;
    while (cin >> x) {
        nums.push_back(x);
    }
    // Assume at least 7 numbers
    int n = nums[0]; // not used
    int a[3] = { nums[1], nums[2], nums[3] };
    int b[3] = { nums[4], nums[5], nums[6] };

    int min_val = positive(a[0] - b[0] - b[2])
                + positive(a[1] - b[0] - b[1])
                + positive(a[2] - b[1] - b[2]);
    int max_val = min(a[0], b[1])
                + min(a[1], b[2])
                + min(a[2], b[0]);

    cout << min_val << " " << max_val << endl;
    return 0;
}
